comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Outsourced services provider paid a revenue share by universities; doesn't operate institutions or collect tuition directly, mainly one client.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Operates for-profit allied health and nursing colleges funded by tuition and student aid, similar to Rasmussen, though smaller and regional.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: For-profit online adult university operator funded by Title IV tuition, with health sciences programs, same model as APEI.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Operates online and campus universities for working adults with military and employer tuition channels, closely matching APEI.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly K-12 virtual schools funded by public school per-pupil payments, a different customer and funding model from adult higher education.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Postsecondary for-profit career school operator on tuition and Title IV aid, though focused on trades, so a looser fit.
